tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully executed/ supplied Carbon Molecular Sieves, to any reputed organization, in a single order of value not less than Rs. 2.70 Lakhs within any one financial year during the previous five years (2021-22 to 2025-26). Bidder shall furnish a copy of Purchase Order/ LOA

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- copy of Purchase Order/ LOA.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have proven financial capability and have a minimum average turnover of Rs. 5.40 Lakhs during any two financial years of the last five preceding years (2025-26, 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 & 2021-22). The bidder shall furnish P&L statement/ audited balance sheet duly certified by a charted accountant to establish annual turnover requirement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a Manufacturer or an Authorized Dealer of Carbon Molecular Sieves. Manufacturers shall provide documentary proof of manufacturing status. Authorized dealers shall furnish a Letter of Authorization from the manufacturer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Letter of Authorization from the manufacturer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have valid GST registration & shall furnish copy of GST registration certificate as a documentary proof.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: P&L statement/ audited balance sheet duly certified by a charted accountant
proof of manufacturing status/Letter of Authorization from the manufacturer.
